name: WILLOW
recent: 公司于2026年10月19日召开特别股东大会，通过出售Willowglen (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.及Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd.全部股权予Elixir II Pte. Ltd.，并批准公司易名为Willownex Berhad。11月18日公布季度业绩，同日宣布在新加坡获得总值2880万令吉的保安合约。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过以4000万令吉现金出售Willowglen (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.全部股权。
股东通过以1.752亿令吉出售Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd.全部股权，其中7200万令吉现金及1.032亿令吉由Elixir II发行新股支付。
公司获得新加坡总值2880万令吉的保安合约。
risks: 出售Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd.的代价中有1.032亿令吉以Elixir II新股支付，公司将成为Elixir II股东。
买卖协议的Long Stop Date已由6个月延长至8个月。

news.title: Willownex Wins RM28.8 Million in Singapore Security Contracts
Willownex secures RM28.8mil worth of contracts in Singapore

recent_en: The company held an EGM on 19 October 2026, approving the disposal of 100% equity interest in Willowglen (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. and Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd. to Elixir II Pte. Ltd., and the change of name to Willownex Berhad. On 18 November, it announced quarterly results and secured RM28.8 million in security contracts in Singapore.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the disposal of 100% equity interest in Willowglen (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. for RM40.0 million cash.
Shareholders approved the disposal of 100% equity interest in Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd. for RM175.2 million, satisfied via RM72.0 million cash and RM103.2 million in new Elixir II shares.
The company secured RM28.8 million worth of security contracts in Singapore.
risks_en: RM103.2 million of the consideration for the Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd. disposal is satisfied via new Elixir II shares, making the company a shareholder of Elixir II.
The Long Stop Date of the sale and purchase agreements has been extended from six to eight months.
